# Read the H5AD file
adata = sc.read_h5ad('VentoTormoData.h5ad')

# Display basic information about the dataset
print("Dataset shape:", adata.shape)
print("Observations (cells):", adata.n_obs)
print("Variables (genes):", adata.n_vars)

# Make gene_symbols the index so Scanpy can find your genes
print("\nOriginal var_names:", adata.var_names[:5])
# Convert categorical to string to avoid issues with make_unique
adata.var_names = adata.var['gene_symbols'].astype(str)
adata.var_names_make_unique()  # In case there are duplicate gene symbols
print("Updated var_names:", adata.var_names[:5])

# Create a column that highlights only the trophoblast types
# Convert to string to avoid categorical issues
adata.obs['CTB_celltypes'] = adata.obs['cell_type'].astype(str)

# Set all other cell types to 'Other'
ctb_types = ['extravillous trophoblast', 'syncytiotrophoblast cell', 'placental villous trophoblast']
adata.obs.loc[~adata.obs['cell_type'].isin(ctb_types), 'CTB_celltypes'] = 'Other'

print(f"\nCell type distribution:")
print(adata.obs['CTB_celltypes'].value_counts())

In [5]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1, 3,
    figsize=(18, 5),
    constrained_layout=True  # better than tight_layout
)

# 1️⃣ Cell types (legend on data = no horizontal squeeze)
sc.pl.umap(
    adata,
    color='cell_type',
    ax=axes[0],
    show=False,
    frameon=False,
    palette='tab20',
    legend_loc='on data',   # avoids right margin squeeze
    legend_fontsize=6,
    size=5
)

# 2️⃣ VGLL1
sc.pl.umap(
    adata,
    color='VGLL1',
    ax=axes[1],
    show=False,
    cmap='RdBu',
    use_raw=False,
    frameon=False,
    size=5
)

# 3️⃣ EGFR
sc.pl.umap(
    adata,
    color='EGFR',
    ax=axes[2],
    show=False,
    cmap='RdBu',
    use_raw=False,
    frameon=False,
    size=5
)

# Rasterize scatter only
for ax in axes:
    for coll in ax.collections:
        coll.set_rasterized(True)

plt.savefig('VentoTormo_VGLL1_EGFR_figS2f.svg', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# Score the three gene sets on Arutyunyan data
gene_sets = {
    'CTB1': CTB1_genes,
    'CTB2': CTB2_genes,
    'CTB3': CTB3_genes
}

for name, genes in gene_sets.items():
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"Processing {name} on Arutyunyan data...")
    print(f"{'='*50}")
    
    genes_clean = [g.strip() for g in genes]
    genes_in_data = [g for g in genes_clean if g in adata_arut.var_names]
    genes_missing = [g for g in genes_clean if g not in adata_arut.var_names]
    
    print(f"{name}: {len(genes_in_data)}/{len(genes_clean)} genes found in dataset")
    if genes_missing:
        print(f"  Missing: {genes_missing[:5]}{'...' if len(genes_missing) > 5 else ''}")
    
    if genes_in_data:
        print(f"  Attempting to score {name}...")
        try:
            sc.tl.score_genes(adata_arut, gene_list=genes_in_data, 
                            score_name=f'{name}_score', 
                            use_raw=False)
            print(f"  ✓ {name}_score computed successfully!")
            print(f"  {name}_score statistics:")
            print(adata_arut.obs[f'{name}_score'].describe())
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ✗ Error scoring {name}: {e}")

# Create UMAP visualization with cell types and scores
if available_scores:
    print(f"\nGenerating UMAP visualizations for {len(available_scores)} score(s) + cell types...")
    
    n_plots = len(available_scores) + 1
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_plots, figsize=(6*n_plots, 5))
    
    if n_plots == 1:
        axes = [axes]
    
    # Plot cell types
    sc.pl.umap(
        adata_arut,
        color='final_annot_all_troph_corrected',
        ax=axes[0],
        show=False,
        title='Arutyunyan Cell Types',
        frameon=False,
        palette='tab20',
        legend_fontsize=6,
        size=5
    )
    
    # Plot scores
    for idx, score_name in enumerate(available_scores):
        sc.pl.umap(
            adata_arut,
            color=score_name,
            cmap='RdBu',
            ax=axes[idx+1],
            show=False,
            title=score_name.replace('_score', ' Score'),
            frameon=False,
            size=5
        )
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    # Rasterize scatter points
    for ax in axes:
        for coll in ax.collections:
            coll.set_rasterized(True)
    
    # Save ONCE after rasterization
    plt.savefig('Arutyunyan_CTB_scores_umap_FigS2e.svg', bbox_inches='tight')
    print("Figure saved as 'Arutyunyan_CTB_scores_umap.svg'")
    
    plt.show()

# Score initial_state genes on Arutyunyan data
print("Scoring initial_state genes on Arutyunyan dataset...")
genes_clean = [g.strip() for g in initial_state]
genes_in_data = [g for g in genes_clean if g in adata_arut.var_names]
genes_missing = [g for g in genes_clean if g not in adata_arut.var_names]

print(f"initial_state: {len(genes_in_data)}/{len(genes_clean)} genes found in dataset")
if genes_missing:
    print(f"  Missing: {genes_missing[:5]}{'...' if len(genes_missing) > 5 else ''}")

if genes_in_data:
    try:
        sc.tl.score_genes(adata_arut, gene_list=genes_in_data, 
                        score_name='initial_state_score', 
                        use_raw=False)
        print(f"  ✓ initial_state_score computed successfully!")
        print(f"  initial_state_score statistics:")
        print(adata_arut.obs['initial_state_score'].describe())
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ Error scoring initial_state: {e}")
